title: Vendor SLA & Incident Management
description: A high-performance backend microservice built with Go (Golang) to track Service Level Agreements (SLA) and manage operational incidents for supply chain logistics.

problem.title: The Challenge
problem.content: Managing Service Level Agreements (SLA) across multiple logistics vendors required processing thousands of status update events daily. The previous system struggled with concurrency and memory bloat.

solution.title: Our Approach
solution.content:
We developed a lightweight, highly concurrent backend service using Go.

### Key Architectural Decisions:
1. **Golang Concurrency**: Leveraged goroutines and channels to process incoming webhook events concurrently without blocking.
2. **Chi Router**: Implemented `go-chi` for fast, idiomatic HTTP routing.
3. **PostgreSQL**: Designed an optimized schema to store incident logs and SLA metrics.
4. **Templ SSR**: Used Templ to render fast, lightweight server-side HTML dashboards instead of a heavy SPA.

impact.title: Business Impact
impact.content: The Go-based service dramatically reduced server resource consumption while processing 10x the amount of concurrent events compared to the legacy system.

results.title: Key Results
results.content:
- **High Concurrency** capabilities using Go
- **Reduced Memory Footprint** by 80%
- **Fast Rendering** with Server-Side Rendering (Templ)
- **Reliable SLA Tracking** across all logistics partners
